title: Off-by-one in declared-span verification

intent: a one-character regression in a shared verifier; the agent must locate it from failing-check names, not from a described diff

mutations.find: Boolean(declared) && declared.end - declared.start === quote.length && text.slice(declared.start, declared.end) === quote;
